description: Authorised overnight backlog for the Business Agent Lab MVP. Only these tasks may run. The supervisor stops when they are complete; it never adds work. Each task's check command is its acceptance test; the log is saved as evidence.

tasks.title: One end-to-end NATEA scenario with the deterministic mock adapter
acceptance: Inquiry reaches a reviewable draft (needs_review) with classification, facts, missing info and quality review
Approval saves the result and creates exactly one Maya handoff

tasks.title: Persistence and review decisions (approve / request changes / hold)
acceptance: Revision creates a new attempt and preserves earlier drafts
Approval saves the approved version
Hold keeps the decision pending
Pending approval survives restart
tasks.check: node --no-warnings --test --test-name-pattern='request changes|hold|pending approval survives' test/workflow.test.js test/recovery.test.js

tasks.title: Business separation enforced in data access
acceptance: A business scope cannot read or write another business's requests, runs, drafts, results, events or decisions
HTTP API refuses cross-business run ids

tasks.title: Restart recovery and bounded retries
acceptance: SIGKILLed worker's run resumes without duplicate step completion
Quality repair limit (2) reached → blocked with pending decision
Step retry limit reached → failed
Concurrent workers never double-process

tasks.title: Four-hour checkpoint and coding supervisor controls
acceptance: App checkpoint has one recommended decision, alternatives and exact resume instructions
Supervisor start/stop/status/resume tested
Deadline and stop terminate child processes
Identical failures stop retrying; permission denial blocks

tasks.title: Replaceable model adapter; missing credentials shown honestly
acceptance: Without key + budget the real adapter is reported disabled with reasons
Requesting real mode without credentials falls back to mock and says why
Calling the disabled real adapter blocks the run instead of retrying

tasks.title: Live real-model smoke test (one bounded call)
acceptance: One real model call drafts scenario 1 within the configured budget and passes deterministic quality review

tasks.title: Validate NATEA scenarios 2 and 3 (international buyer, automation)
acceptance: Each scenario produces classification, known facts with quotes, missing info, brief, next actions, draft, quality review and a handoff after approval
No invented prices, availability or legal conclusions

tasks.title: Dashboard and handoff exercised in a real browser
acceptance: Main journey passes in Chromium: intake → review → request changes → approve → copy handoff → business switch → checkpoint
Phone width has no horizontal scroll
No console errors

tasks.title: Full test suite green
acceptance: npm test exits 0

decisions.title: Authorise a small budget for real-model drafts?
decisions.why: No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or LAB_MAX_BUDGET_USD is configured in this environment, so every business output tonight is simulated by the mock adapter. A live smoke test and real drafts need your explicit authorisation and budget.
decisions.recommendation: Review the three mock NATEA drafts first. If the workflow shape is right, authorise a small cap (e.g. $2) and run the one-call smoke test.
alternatives: Keep mock-only until the dashboard and handoff format are final.
Authorise a larger budget and switch all businesses to real drafts (still reviewed; nothing is sent).
decisions.resume:
export LAB_ADAPTER=anthropic LAB_MAX_BUDGET_USD=2   # ANTHROPIC_API_KEY must already be set in your shell
echo '{"authorize-real-model": "approved: $2 cap"}' > data/decisions-answered.json
npm run supervisor -- resume --detach   # if the 8h window has ended first: npm run supervisor -- reset-window --hours 8
